class_name: 逆接-想外-ニモカカワラズ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1: author → mechanical attachment gate → cold review → fixes applied → gate re-run

glosses: in spite of the fact that …
patterns.usage_note: The formal written counterpart of のに: a condition that should have produced one outcome, and an outcome that defied it, reported with a note of surprise or reproach. A bare noun works directly (大雨にもかかわらず), as do a plain verb, an i-adjective and た forms; in careful prose a na-adjective or a predicative noun takes である first (危険であるにもかかわらず). それにもかかわらず serves as the sentence-initial conjunction. Where をよそに says someone deliberately brushed the circumstance aside, にもかかわらず only says the circumstance failed to have its expected effect.

examples.ruby: 大雨[おおあめ]にもかかわらず、会場[かいじょう]には長[なが]い列[れつ]ができていた。
examples.english: Despite the downpour, a long line had formed outside the venue.

examples.ruby: 何度[なんど]も注意[ちゅうい]したにもかかわらず、彼[かれ]は同[おな]じ失敗[しっぱい]を繰[く]り返[かえ]した。
examples.english: Even though I warned him time and again, he made the very same mistake.

examples.ruby: 医者[いしゃ]に止[と]められているにもかかわらず、父[ちち]は煙草[たばこ]をやめない。
examples.english: My father's doctor has told him to stop, and yet he still won't give up cigarettes.

patterns.usage_note: A written-style N1 expression built on 余所 ('somewhere else'): the subject shoves other people's 心配, 反対, 批判 or 期待 off to one side and goes ahead anyway. It attaches to a noun, and to a clause only through の (騒いでいるのをよそに). The feeling disregarded is typically someone else's rather than the subject's own, and the sentence usually carries a shade of disapproval or detachment, which is what separates it from the neutral にもかかわらず.

examples.ruby: 周囲[しゅうい]の心配[しんぱい]をよそに、彼[かれ]は単身[たんしん]で山[やま]へ向[む]かった。
examples.english: Heedless of everyone's concern, he set off for the mountains alone.

examples.ruby: 住民[じゅうみん]の反対[はんたい]をよそに、工事[こうじ]は着々[ちゃくちゃく]と進[すす]められた。
examples.english: In defiance of the residents' objections, the construction pushed steadily ahead.

examples.ruby: 彼女[かのじょ]は母[はは]の落胆[らくたん]をよそに、留学[りゅうがく]の準備[じゅんび]を進[すす]めた。
examples.english: Paying no attention to her mother's dismay, she pressed ahead with her plans to study abroad.
